description: Wheelbase brings your rental business into ChatGPT. Connect your account and ask about your bookings, fleet, customers, and payments in plain language — "how many bookings this week?", "look up Jane Smith's reservations", "which deposits are still on hold after the trip ended?", "how many vehicles are unpublished?". You can also start a booking or send a checkout link to a customer. Works with your existing Wheelbase account.

defaultPrompt: What bookings start next week, and what's the total revenue?
What's my fleet utilization for the next 30 days?
How is my fleet doing — what's listed, unpublished, and sitting idle?
